description: A festival awards producer must approve the final prize-disbursement and ceremony-announcement package for the festival's top award, including the amount, recipient, tax treatment, payment route, sponsor credit, and public wording.

shared_context.S1: The festival's top award will be announced at the closing ceremony on Saturday.
shared_context.S2: The draft awards packet lists a $25,000 prize payable by check to the film's director, with a generic sponsor acknowledgment.
shared_context.S3: Mara has authority to release the final prize instructions and ceremony announcement.
shared_context.S4: The festival's normal final-package meeting includes legal, accounting, finance, and filmmaker-relations signoff before the packet is released.

PF1.text: The countersigned sponsor agreement, filed by legal yesterday, sets the top award at exactly $30,000, makes Lumen Tide Films LLC the recipient, and requires the credit line 'The Horizon Prize presented with support from Northstar Foundation.' The awards packet has not yet been updated.

PF2.text: Sofia's tax review completed this morning determines that the prize payment requires exactly 30 percent withholding before remittance; her review memo is awaiting entry into the awards packet.

PF3.text: The bank confirmed today that Lumen Tide Films LLC can receive the prize only by ACH to its verified festival-payments account, not by paper check; Cal has not yet replaced the draft payment instruction.

PF4.text: The filmmaker's approved publicity sheet specifies that the ceremony announcement must read exactly 'The Horizon Prize goes to Lumen Tide Films LLC for Glass Harbor,' and Nadia received that sheet from the filmmaker's publicist this afternoon.

acceptance_conditions: The prize amount must be exactly $30,000.
The recipient must be Lumen Tide Films LLC.
Exactly 30 percent withholding must be applied, leaving a net payment of $21,000.
Payment must be made by ACH to the verified festival-payments account.
The exact Northstar Foundation sponsor credit must be used.
The ceremony announcement must use the exact approved publicity wording.
The settlement must log legal, tax, bank, and publicity-package commitments.

content_checks.C5: decisions['payment_method'] == "ACH to Lumen Tide Films LLC's verified festival-payments account"
content_checks.C6: decisions['sponsor_credit'] == 'The Horizon Prize presented with support from Northstar Foundation'
content_checks.C7: decisions['announcement_text'] == 'The Horizon Prize goes to Lumen Tide Films LLC for Glass Harbor'
content_checks.C8: any(c['type'] == 'packet_update' and 'Northstar Foundation' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)
content_checks.C9: any(c['type'] == 'packet_update' and ('30%' in c['detail'] or '30 percent' in c['detail']) for c in commitments)
content_checks.C10: any(c['type'] == 'packet_update' and 'ACH' in c['detail'] and 'verified festival-payments account' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)
content_checks.C11: any(c['type'] == 'packet_update' and 'The Horizon Prize goes to Lumen Tide Films LLC for Glass Harbor' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The countersigned agreement changes the prize from 25,000 to exactly 30,000, changes the payee to Lumen Tide Films LLC, and replaces the generic credit with the exact Northstar Foundation wording.
The tax review changes withholding from the unreviewed draft assumption to exactly 30 percent and therefore changes the net payment to exactly 21,000.
The bank confirmation changes the payment route from paper check to ACH to Lumen Tide Films LLC's verified festival-payments account.
The approved publicity sheet changes the generic ceremony announcement to the exact wording naming Lumen Tide Films LLC and Glass Harbor.
